# Kling 3.0

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a model-specific deep dive for Kling 3.0 (Kuaishou's third-generation multi-shot video model) on RunComfy: all six rendering endpoints across three quality tiers (Standard up to 1080p for fast iteration, Pro for hero-quality 1080p, 4K for native 3840×2160 masters) and two modes (text-to-video, image-to-video), with per-endpoint pricing (e.g. ~$0.084/s without audio), native synchronized audio, consistent character identity across shots, and a multi-prompt segment system for multi-scene generations. Calls `runcomfy run kling/kling-3-0/<tier>/<mode>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Complement to the meta-router prime-skills-ai-video-generation: that one decides which model fits; this one is the full operating manual for Kling 3.0 once chosen. Requires a RunComfy account, the RunComfy CLI (`npm i -g @runcomfy/cli`), and generation calls are billed against API credits — a paid service. Honest notes: the source docs use RunComfy's "Pro Pack" marketing voice and carry tracking links; the technical content (endpoints, schemas, examples) is real and documented. By @prime-skills, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
